wholePhysicalScope: The matched Tower Hill place, both surviving structures and their native features in Trinity Square Gardens. The current garden shape follows the surveyed retaining walls. Existing stone surfaces and architecturally significant form are drawn from the published originals.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the Doric pavilion and the measured sunken bronze memorial court.
limitations: Pavilion roof profile and individual pylon heights are reconstructed from photography at model scale. The plates, decorative relief blocks and compass convey the forms of the memorial at medium detail. Engraved names and individual sculptural likeness are outside the model scope.
Nearby park, 2005 Falklands monument, and unrelated buildings remain supplied by the existing world.
